Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/tests/02-course-browse.spec.ts

This is a Playwright test file for course browsing (User Story 1 + User Story 3).

The test file should contain these test suites:

1. "Course Browse Smoke" (US1):
   a. "browse page loads and shows seeded courses" — logs in as Learner (alice@example.com/password123), navigates to /Courses/Index, verifies at least 10 course cards visible
   b. "click course card navigates to detail page" — clicks first course card link, verifies /Courses/Detail loads with correct title
   c. "unauthenticated user can browse courses" — uses fresh context, navigates to /Courses/Index, verifies page loads

2. "Course Search" (US3):
   a. "search by keyword filters results" — types "C#" in search box (#search-input), waits for HTMX update, verifies only "Introduction to C#" appears
   b. "clear button resets search" — clicks Clear button, verifies all 10 courses reappear
   c. "search with no results shows empty state" — types "xyznonexistent", verifies no course cards match

3. "Course Category Filter" (US3):
   a. "selecting Programming category shows 4 courses"
   b. "selecting Design category shows 2 courses"
   c. "selecting Database category shows 2 courses"
   d. "selecting Tools category shows 2 courses"
   e. "selecting All Categories shows all 10 courses"

4. "Course Detail Navigation" (US3):
   a. "clicking a course card loads detail page with correct info" — clicks "Introduction to C#", verifies title matches, description contains "C# programming"
   b. "SCORM course detail shows launch option" — verifies launch button is present on SCORM course

- Helper function to login: navigate to /Account/Login, fill credentials, submit, wait for redirect
- For HTMX waits, use: await page.waitForTimeout(500) after triggering HTMX events, or wait for specific content
- Course cards are .card elements within #course-list
